high.title: Danantara Boss Speaks Out About IHSG Plunge After BUMN Export Entity Formation
high.summary: IHSG fell 0.82% to 6,318.50 after President Prabowo announced the formation of PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia to manage strategic commodity exports including palm oil, coal, and ferro alloy. The index continued declining to 6,094 the next day, losing 233 points (3.54%).

high.title: IHSG Plunges Nearly Below 6,000 Level
high.summary: Indonesian stock index IHSG closed at 6,094, down 233 points (3.54%) in a significant market selloff. The index opened in positive territory at 6,366 but fell throughout the day, reaching a low of 6,080.

high.title: Airlangga Will Explain BUMN Export Policy to Investors After IHSG Collapse
high.summary: Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto will provide detailed explanations to investors about the new export policy through PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia after market turmoil. The transition to the new BUMN export entity is scheduled for June 1, 2026.

high.title: Luhut Apologizes to Global Investors
high.summary: National Economic Council Chairman Luhut Pandjaitan apologized to global investors and investment managers in Singapore regarding Indonesia's volatile financial market conditions due to geopolitical sentiment and rising oil prices. This signals serious concern about investor confidence in Indonesian markets.

high.title: Airlangga Denies BUMN Export Entity Caused IHSG Crash
high.summary: Coordinating Economic Minister Airlangga Hartarto denied that the formation of PT Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia caused the IHSG decline. He attributed the weakness to global sentiment including MSCI index rebalancing, though the timing coincided with the export policy announcement.

medium.title: Prabowo Threatens Corrupt Officials: Can Track with Radar to Underground Bunkers
medium.summary: President Prabowo warned government officials against corruption, claiming modern radar technology can detect underground bunkers used to hide wealth. This represents a strong anti-corruption stance that could impact business confidence and governance.

medium.title: Giant Gas Reserves Discovered in Kutai
medium.summary: Ministry of Energy discovered massive Geliga gas reserves in Kutai Basin, East Kalimantan with potential of 5 TCF gas and 300 million BOE condensate. Combined with existing Gula field, total potential reaches 7 TCF gas and 375 million BOE condensate.

medium.title: Djarum Group's SUPR Plans Delisting, Offers Rp 45,000 per Share
medium.summary: PT Solusi Tunas Pratama Tbk (SUPR), a major Djarum Group company, plans to delist from Indonesia Stock Exchange and go private. The controlling shareholder PT Profesional Telekomunikasi Indonesia is evaluating long-term business strategy for more efficient asset management.

medium.title: OJK Admits Indonesia's Carbon Trading is Small, Loses to Europe and China
medium.summary: Financial Services Authority acknowledges Indonesia's IDXCarbon trading volume is only Rp 93.7 billion, significantly smaller than EU's $700 billion and China's $10-40 billion. This highlights the early stage of Indonesia's carbon market development.

medium.title: Prabowo's Message to Danantara: Manage Rp 17,000 Trillion Carefully, Don't Let People's Money Leak
medium.summary: President Prabowo warned Danantara management to carefully handle state assets worth Rp 17,000 trillion across 1,040 SOEs valued at nearly US$1 trillion. This emphasizes the massive scale of state enterprise consolidation under Danantara.

medium.title: Government Revokes 2,231 Licenses of Problematic Fertilizer Retailers and Distributors
medium.summary: Ministry of Agriculture revoked 2,231 licenses of problematic subsidized fertilizer retailers and distributors to ensure fertilizers reach rightful farmers and close distribution mafia loopholes. This is part of broader efforts against food mafia that handled 92 cases in 2024-2026.

medium.title: FTSE Russell Removes 4 Indonesian Stocks, Here Are Their Violations
medium.summary: FTSE Russell removed four Indonesian stocks from FTSE Global Equity Index Series including DSSA for high shareholding concentration. This impacts foreign investment flows into these stocks and reflects concerns about corporate governance standards.

medium.title: BEI Welcomes 7 Million New Investors
medium.summary: Indonesia Stock Exchange recorded 7.4 million new investors from January to May 20, 2026, bringing total investors to 27.4 million. This represents strong public confidence in Indonesian capital markets despite recent volatility.
